purpose: Machine-checkable map of where a user opens licence texts offline inside the packaged client and inside an exported game. Paths are relative to the scan root. status values: required (must be present), required-when-engine-bundled (must be present only if the engine is actually bundled), conditional (must be present only if the named code is included), missing (not present today; a real gap), reference (repo-side official text, not expected in the package).

rules: A text with status required must exist at root/file in the scanned tree.
required-when-engine-bundled is enforced only when the scan finds an engine binary or the engine notice path.
conditional is reported, never silently treated as satisfied or violated.
missing is a recorded gap: the check fails when a shipped component names it, and the report states the exact path a human must create.
reference entries are repo-side official texts under desktop/delivery/licensing/texts/ and are verified to exist there; they are not expected inside the package or export.
No path may be absolute or escape the scan root.
